79283-mata-hari.title: _Courtesan and Spy_
79283-mata-hari.creator: Major Thomas Coulson, O.B.E.
79283-mata-hari.description: A book by Major Thomas Coulson, O.B.E.. ion, a flair for the sensational, the sentimental, and the poetic, preaching a gospel of love which had to be communicated in whispered confidences, has this woman not all the characteristics of an ideal heroine for a successful novel?

arxiv-2004-03456.title: Binary and Multiclass Classifiers based on Multitaper Spectral Features for Epilepsy Detection
arxiv-2004-03456.creator: Jefferson Tales Oliva, João Luís Garcia Rosa
arxiv-2004-03456.description: Abstract Epilepsy is one of the most common neurological disorders that can be diagnosed through electroencephalogram (EEG), in which the following epileptic events can be observed: pre-ictal, ictal, post-ictal, and interictal. In this paper, we present a novel method for epilepsy detection into two differentiation contexts: binary and multiclass classification.

arxiv-2011-12298.title: Grain growth for astrophysics with Discontinuous Galerkin schemes Grain growth for astrophysics with Discontinuous Galerkin schemes – Data availability 2020
arxiv-2011-12298.creator: Maxime Lombart, Guillaume Laibe
arxiv-2011-12298.description: Abstract Depending on their sizes, dust grains store more or less charges, catalyse more or less chemical reactions, intercept more or less photons and stick more or less efficiently to form embryos of planets. Hence the need for an accurate treatment of dust coagulation and fragmentation in numerical modelling.

arxiv-2104-02753.title: Fiscal Stimulus of Last Resort
arxiv-2104-02753.creator: Alessandro Piergallini
arxiv-2104-02753.description: Abstract I examine global dynamics in a monetary model with overlapping generations of finite-horizon agents and a binding lower bound on nominal interest rates. Debt targeting rules exacerbate the possibility of self-fulfilling liquidity traps, for agents expect austerity following deflationary slumps.

arxiv-2210-08232.title: A tutorial on implementing De Morgan cubical type theory
arxiv-2210-08232.creator: Tesla Zhang
arxiv-2210-08232.description: Abstract . This tutorial explains (one way) how to implement De Morgan cubical type theory to people who know how to implement a dependent type theory. It contains an introduction to basic concepts of cubes, type checking algorithms under a cofibration, the idea of ‘‘transportation rules’’ and cubical operations.

arxiv-2302-06285.title: Do PAC-Learners Learn the Marginal Distribution?
arxiv-2302-06285.creator: Max Hopkins, Daniel M. Kane, Shachar Lovett, Gaurav Mahajan
arxiv-2302-06285.description: Abstract The Fundamental Theorem of PAC Learning asserts that learnability of a concept class H H is equivalent to the uniform convergence of empirical error in H H to its mean, or equivalently, to the problem of density estimation , learnability of the underlying marginal distribution with respect to events in H H .

arxiv-2304-12736.title: Effect of triangularity on plasma turbulence and the SOL-width scaling in L-mode diverted tokamak configurations
arxiv-2304-12736.creator: K. Lim, M. Giacomin, P. Ricci, A. Coelho, O. Février, D. Mancini, D. Silvagni, L. Stenger
arxiv-2304-12736.description: Abstract The effect of triangularity on tokamak boundary plasma turbulence is investigated by using global, flux-driven, three-dimensional, two-fluid simulations. The simulations show that negative triangularity stabilizes boundary plasma turbulence, and linear investigations reveal that this is due to a reduction of the magnetic curvature drive of interchange instabilities, such as the resistive ballooning mode.

arxiv-2410-23541.title: Inferring cosmology from gravitational waves using non-parametric detector-frame mass distribution
arxiv-2410-23541.creator: Thomas C. K. Ng, Stefano Rinaldi, Otto A. Hannuksela
arxiv-2410-23541.description: Abstract The challenge of understanding the Universe’s dynamics, particularly the Hubble tension, requires precise measurements of the Hubble constant. Building upon the existing spectral-siren method, which capitalizes on population information from gravitational-wave sources, this paper explores an alternative method to analyze the population data to obtain the cosmological parameters in Λ \Lambda CDM.

arxiv-2506-11908.title: Spectra-to-Structure and Structure-to-Spectra Inference Across the Periodic Table
arxiv-2506-11908.creator: Yufeng Wang, Peiyao Wang, Lu Ma, Yuewei Lin, Qun Liu, Haibin Ling
arxiv-2506-11908.description: Abstract X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy (XAS) is a powerful technique for probing local atomic environments, yet its interpretation remains limited by the need for expert-driven analysis, computationally expensive simulations, and element-specific heuristics. Recent advances in machine learning have shown promise for accelerating XAS interpretation, but many existing models are narrowly focused on specific elements, edge types, or spectral regimes.

arxiv-2508-01288.title: Cascade Crack in Chain of Beads
arxiv-2508-01288.creator: Meysam Bagheri, Thorsten Pöschel
arxiv-2508-01288.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Meysam Bagheri, Thorsten Pöschel. We consider a homogeneous chain of spheres linked by liquid bridges under tension. The rupture of a single liquid bridge leads to a fragmentation cascade driven by the inverse relation between the capillary force and the sphere distances. The initial length of the liquid bridges determines the number and size of the fragments and the velocity of the fragmentation front.

arxiv-2510-06035.title: Universal Neural Architecture Space: Covering ConvNets, Transformers and Everything in Between
arxiv-2510-06035.creator: Ondřej Týbl, Lukáš Neumann
arxiv-2510-06035.description: Abstract We introduce Uni versal N eural A rchitecture S pace ( UniNAS ), a generic search space for neural architecture search (NAS) which unifies convolutional networks, transformers, and their hybrid architectures under a single, flexible framework. Our approach enables discovery of novel architectures as well as analyzing existing architectures in a common framework.

arxiv-2604-04802.creator: Yaniv Plan, Matthew S. Scott, Ozgur Yilmaz

arxiv-2605-01439.creator: Akira Kawano, Ilia Soroka, Greg J. Stephens

britannica-1911-jerahmeel.title: Jerahmeel (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-jerahmeel.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jerahmeel.description: Article 'Jerahmeel' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. clan which with Caleb, the Kenites and others, occupied the southern steppes of Palestine, probably in the district around Arad, about 17 m. It was on friendly terms with David during his residence at Ziklag (1 Sam. 29), and it was apparently in his reign that the various elements of the south were united and were reckoned to Israel.

pmc-10568416.title: Subregional analysis of striatum iron in Parkinson’s disease and rapid eye movement sleep behaviour disorder
pmc-10568416.creator: Erind Alushaj, Dimuthu Hemachandra, Alan Kuurstra, Ravi S. Menon, Hooman Ganjavi, Manas Sharma, Alia Kashgari, Jennifer Barr, William Reisman, Ali R. Khan, Penny A. MacDonald
pmc-10568416.description: Highlights•Parcellation with tractography could enhance striatal susceptibility differences.•No susceptibility group level differences were found in standard striatum anatomy.•Caudal motor striatum susceptibility was lower in early Parkinson’s disease.•RBD patients did not differ from either group warranting further investigating. Introduction Parkinson’s disease (PD) is the second most common and fastest-growing neurodegenerative disease in the world (Dorsey et al., 2018).

pmc-10609863.title: JTE-013 Alleviates Pulmonary Fibrosis by Affecting the RhoA/YAP Pathway and Mitochondrial Fusion/Fission
pmc-10609863.creator: Jiaxu Zhou, Yilan Song, Xingmei Wang, Xinrui Li, Chang Liu, Chenchen Tian, Chongyang Wang, Liangchang Li, Guanghai Yan, Hong Cui
pmc-10609863.description: Pulmonary fibrosis may be due to the proliferation of fibroblasts and the aggregation of extracellular matrix, resulting in the stimulation of inflammation damage, destroying lung tissue structure, seriously affecting the patient’s respiratory function, and even leading to death. We investigated the role and mechanism of JTE-013 in attenuating bleomycin (BLM)-induced pulmonary fibrosis. BLM-induced pulmonary fibrosis was established in mice.

pmc-10652874.title: Investigation into the mechanism of action of the antimicrobial peptide epilancin 15X
pmc-10652874.creator: Chunyu Wu, B. Alexis Lower, Ryan Moreira, Darian Dorantes, Tung Le, Constantin Giurgiu, Yanxiang Shi, Wilfred A. van der Donk
pmc-10652874.description: Addressing the current antibiotic-resistance challenge would be aided by the identification of compounds with novel mechanisms of action. Epilancin 15X, a lantibiotic produced by Staphylococcus epidermidis 15 × 154, displays antimicrobial activity in the submicromolar range against a subset of pathogenic Gram-positive bacteria. S. epidermidis is a common member of the human skin or mucosal microbiota.

pmc-11687378.title: How do mentors perceive and perform their role in a reflection-based mentoring programme for medical students?
pmc-11687378.creator: Fleur Helewaut, Jan Reniers, Ellen Paelinck, Serhat Yildirim
pmc-11687378.description: ObjectivesTo explore how mentors perceive and perform their role in a longitudinal mentorship programme with the objective of guiding medical students in becoming reflective learners. MethodsA qualitative exploratory study was conducted using semi-structured interviews with 16 mentors from the Ghent University medical education mentoring programme. Participants were selected by purposeful sampling on gender, years of experience and area of specialisation.

pmc-11714935.title: Individuals with Alzheimer’s disease living alone in Sweden receive limited comprehensive care
pmc-11714935.creator: Dorota Religa
pmc-11714935.description: BackgroundA significant number of individuals with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) reside independently in their homes, yet there is limited understanding of whether they receive comparable diagnostic and treatment standards for AD compared to their cohabiting counterparts. The prevalence of dementia is rising, particularly among the elderly, with approximately 150,000 individuals affected by dementia in Sweden, two‐thirds of whom have AD.

pmc-12450722.title: Carbon ion combined photon radiotherapy induces ferroptosis via NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy in glioblastoma
pmc-12450722.creator: Li Chen, Wanzun Lin, Ziyu Le, Fangzhu Wan, Haojiong Zhang, Shikai Geng, Qingting Huang, Jing Gao, Wei Hu, Huaiyuan Chen, Xingyu Liu, Chunlin Shao, Fengtao Su, Jiade J Lu, Lin Kong
pmc-12450722.description: Glioblastoma (GBM), the most prevalent and lethal primary malignancy of the central nervous system, remains refractory to conventional photon radiotherapy due to inherent limitations in dose distribution. Although carbon ion radiotherapy offers distinct advantages, including its characteristic Bragg peak deposition and superior relative biological effectiveness, its clinical application is constrained by high costs and increased toxicity.

pmc-12785123.title: LPS-Stressed Bovine Endometrial Cells upon Morulae in a Transwell Model of Embryo—Maternal Talk
pmc-12785123.creator: Anna Lange-Consiglio, Giulia Gaspari, Paola Gagni, Giampaolo Bosi, Pietro Riccaboni, Fausto Cremonesi
pmc-12785123.description: Simple SummaryEndometritis causes preimplantation embryonic loss due to altered uterine nutrient composition. This study simulated a uterine inflammatory process stressing bovine endometrial cells by bacterial lipopolysaccharide with the aim of evaluating the effects of endometritis in early embryo development by using an in vitro model that allows communication between cells and embryos by porous inserts.

pmc-13359101.title: Influence of CO2‑Regenerative Film Properties in Enhancing C2+ Products Selectivity While Mitigating CO2 Crossover
pmc-13359101.creator: Ashok Kumar Ummireddi, Ananya Vasudevan, Jithu Raj, Mohammad Fahim Yasir, Jingjie Wu
pmc-13359101.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Zero-gap anion-exchange membrane electrode assembly (AEMEA) electrolyzers operating in alkaline media face challenges such as CO2 crossover and salting-out. The bipolar membrane electrode assembly (BPMEA) electrolyzer, using DI water as the electrolyte, addresses both CO2 crossover and salting-out issues. As cations, which are crucial in stabilizing the CO2R intermediates, are absent in the electrolyte, cations embedded in the AEM play an important role in dictating the CO2R selectivity and activity in BPMEA systems.

pmc-13476972.title: Feasibility of flexible and navigable suction ureteral access sheath in pediatric ureteroscopy: A systematic review from the European Association of Urology Section of Endourology
pmc-13476972.creator: Ali Talyshinskii, Patrick Juliebø-Jones, Vineet Gauhar, Steffi Kar Kei Yuen, Selcuk Güven, Theodoros Tokas, Nariman Gadzhiev, Bhaskar Somani
pmc-13476972.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveThe introduction of a flexible and navigable suction ureteral access sheath (FANS-UAS) has further enhanced retrograde intrarenal surgery (RIRS) by improving kidney stone clearance and reducing operative challenges. However, evidence for its use in the pediatric population remains sparse.

pmc-13628133.title: Hinge-region Cys-to-Ser mutation enables homogeneous DAR6 anti-c-Met biparatopic ADCs with tolerable O-glycosylation
pmc-13628133.creator: Deyong Song, Zhenduo Shen, Xiaolin Zhu, Haifeng Zhao, Yingdi Wang, Junmei Zhang, Rui Li, Hongguang Xu, Zengjin Cheng, Xiaoju Ma, Haixia Lin, Changlin Dou, Min Xiao

pmc-13676224.title: Physical Parameters Influencing the Rate of Subretinal Injection: A Microfluidic Analysis
pmc-13676224.creator: Aaron Nagiel, Lamberto Rondoni
pmc-13676224.description: PurposeSubretinal injection during vitrectomy has become an important technique owing to the growing number of cell and gene therapy trials for retinal disease. Reducing the injection rate can mitigate trauma or shear forces on the retinal pigment epithelium, yet many surgeons alter the subretinal injection system in ways that could influence this rate.

pmc-13687219.title: Integrated transcriptomic analysis identifies an AKT1-associated metabolic-inflammatory signature in osteoporosis
pmc-13687219.creator: Chenglong Bao, Ronggui Hu
pmc-13687219.description: Osteoporosis is a significant global health challenge, and low bone mineral density (Low-BMD) is a major clinical feature and risk indicator of osteoporosis. Fatty acid metabolism has been increasingly implicated in bone remodeling and inflammatory regulation, but the transcriptomic links between fatty acid metabolism and immune-inflammatory alterations in Low-BMD remain unclear.
